from.place: proof, finite flatness identifies f_*O_X as a finite locally free module, with rank locally constant

title: Pushforward of a finite flat morphism is locally free of locally constant rank
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $f_*\mathcal O_X$ is a finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module: there is an open cover of $Y$ on which it is isomorphic to $\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus d}$, with the rank $d$ locally constant on $Y$ (equivalently, $Y$ is a disjoint union of open-and-closed pieces on which the rank is constant).
